verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own referrals feature for inviting coworkers, investors, and friends to refer candidates for its jobs, which covers the submit side of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a referrer tracking status or seeing which stage their referral has reached. missing for 10: referrer-facing status tracking, visibility into the referral's pipeline stage, detailed referral submission docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands

citations.quote: Invite coworkers, investors, and friends to refer candidates for your jobs.
